pkgmetadata.longdescription: Pure-Python library to inspect, modify and scan the memory of any running process. Supports Cheat Engine-style value scans, pointer chains and array-of-bytes (AOB) pattern search on Windows, Linux and macOS via ctypes with no required C extension. An optional NumPy fast-path (USE=speed) and an optional Qt GUI front-end (USE=app) are also available.

use.flag: Pull in numpy for vectorized scan acceleration
